reboot_test_method: For each non-active mode, `sudo nvpmodel -m <id>` was actually invoked with stdin='no\n' (a universal decline -- nvpmodel requires an exact 'YES'/'yes' to proceed, anything else aborts with the mode left unchanged). reboot_required=True iff the string 'Reboot required' appeared in the command's output. After every probe, the active mode was re-queried and asserted unchanged, so this is a safe, real, reproducible empirical test -- not an assumption from documentation.
